purpose: Test the registered reference-anchored prefix-local preference mechanism initialised from the S67 soup champion, with rollouts from the soup's own policy and the frozen reference also the soup. Selection is calibration-only; the one-shot test asks whether the selected preference checkpoint beats the soup champion on MATH while holding GSM8K and MMLU retention.

policy.rollout_policy: the soup champion itself, loaded from the champion checkpoint over the post-trained model directory
policy.reference_policy: the soup champion itself; the frozen reference pi_ref is the same checkpoint the student is initialised from, so the initial preference margin is zero
policy.prompt_protocol: the policy's own chat template, add_generation_prompt=True, enable_thinking=False, the S55/S59 user template

prompts.selection: frontier.rft.stratified_select over the full train split after exclusion, seed 6900, strata (source, difficulty bucket, reasoning-length quartile)

exclude.why: the registered GSM8K calibration split, kept unseen by the training arm
the registered MATH calibration split, kept unseen by the training arm

rollouts.stopping: EOS plus the registered per-row loop cut (trailing 64 = 4x16 or trailing 144 = 3x48); the cut is per sequence and the retained prefix is still verified
rollouts.verification: frontier.rft.verify against the train label; verdict in {correct, wrong, ambiguous, unparseable}
rollouts.pass_rate: p = verified_correct / attempts, attempts counting every sampled completion including truncations and duplicates
rollouts.rejected_side: one failed continuation per problem as token ids only, preferring a non-truncated failure; no decoded failed text is stored
rollouts.ledger: one row per problem with attempts, p, truncation, loop-cut and duplicate counters; written even when every completion fails

pairs.chosen: a verified-correct teacher continuation conditioned on the student's exact token-identical prefix
pairs.rejected: the student's own failed continuation from that same prefix
pairs.prefix_rule: frontier.preference.assert_shared_prefix; a token mismatch fails closed instead of pairing two different prompts

teacher_corpus.reuse_rule: reused only when the corpus row's prompt_ids are token-identical to the rollout prompt_ids; verified before the run on a 200-row sample with 200/200 exact matches

teacher_generation.condition: only when the corpus has no usable teacher row for the problem
teacher_generation.verification: re-verified with frontier.rft.verify; a generated continuation that does not verify is counted, never used

pairs.normal_arm: pairs with weight <= 0 are dropped before budgeting, so the preference arm and the matched SFT control use the identical effective problem set
pairs.recovery_arm: p = 0 problems receive their verified teacher continuation paired with the student's failed continuation, at the mean positive p(1-p) weight of the on-policy pairs

reference.model: the soup champion checkpoint, loaded over the post-trained model directory
reference.cache: per-token log-probabilities for the fixed chosen and rejected actions, one vector per side

lora.targets: every linear layer of the text tower except the output head
lora.merge: scale * B @ A folded into CPU copies of each base weight; the exported checkpoint is a merged full-weight text tower and the adapter is not a deployed identity
lora.initialisation: the student is initialised from the soup champion checkpoint before the adapter is installed

training.objective: reference-anchored prefix-local preference: -log sigmoid(beta * [(s+ - s-) - (r+ - r-)]) with mean-normalised sequence log-probabilities

arms.preference: the normal arm on the positive-weight pairs, w = p(1-p)
arms.matched-sft: completion CE on the chosen continuations of the identical effective problem set, same cadence and processed-token budget; attribution control
arms.recovery: the p = 0 teacher-guided pairs at the matched mean positive weight; trained only if at least 8 recovery pairs exist

mmlu_cal.source: the registered 2,000-item MMLU selection partition, 5-shot lm-evaluation-harness

instrument.protocol: greedy, non-thinking, zero-shot, S54 user template, max_new_tokens 2048

calibration_selection.selection_rule: highest MATH-cal among the preference milestones; tie-break higher GSM8K-cal, then the earlier cadence
calibration_selection.retention_filter: the selected milestone's MMLU-cal must not be more than 1.0 point below the soup's 0.5215; if it is, the next-best MATH-cal milestone is considered
calibration_selection.adoption_gate: the selected milestone's MATH-cal must be strictly greater than the soup's 0.3260 and its GSM8K-cal must not be more than 1.0 point below the soup's 0.609; otherwise the arm is recorded as a calibration-level failure and no test split is read
calibration_selection.control_scoring: the matched SFT control is scored on GSM8K-cal and MATH-cal at the preference-selected cadence
calibration_selection.recovery_scoring: the recovery arm is scored on GSM8K-cal and MATH-cal at the preference-selected cadence only if the preference arm is adopted

one_shot_test.condition: only if the calibration adoption gate passes

instruments.instrument: the pre-registered S67 resolution instrument, revision 21a5633873b6a120296cce3e2df9d5550074f4a3, scored once

one_shot_test.comparison: paired at problem or item level against the stored S67 soup raw dumps, 4,000 resamples, seed 53; the soup is not rescored
one_shot_test.control_attribution: if the preference arm is adopted, the matched SFT control at the same cadence is scored once on MATH-500 and GSM8K test; it is not given a full-MATH run
one_shot_test.no_enlargement: the full-MATH instrument is not enlarged or re-scored on the basis of the result

win_bar.matching: candidate - soup, paired problem-level bootstrap, 4,000 resamples, seed 53, flexible basis

requires.gsm8k: point delta >= -1.0 and 95% interval lower bound >= -1.0
requires.mmlu: point delta >= -1.0 and 95% interval lower bound >= -1.0

win_bar.mmlu_pro: reported as a secondary retention instrument; it is not part of the win bar
win_bar.no_frontier_claim: no external system is compared in this experiment

fallback_route.condition: the preference arm fails the calibration adoption gate or the test win bar
fallback_route.route: the corrected stage-2 recipe (token-normalised objective, long MATH at cap 2500, LoRA) followed by interpolation back toward the post-trained endpoint
fallback_route.cost_arithmetic: emitted to the verdict receipt from measured throughput on this host; no cost number is asserted in this registration
